relationships.description: BCE/VHCI exposes the Touch Bar USB configurations.
BCE/VHCI exposes the lid-angle sensor as USB 05ac:8104.
Internal keyboard and backlight enumerate through BCE/VHCI.
The internal trackpad is a BCE/VHCI child in the inventory.
Biometric operations depend on SEP identity and authorization services.
SEP persistence crosses xART and embedded storage boundaries.
Graphics transitions coordinate GPU, HDA, root port, and mux state.
Wake and completion notifications involve the SMC fabric.
AOP LAS naming suggests ownership; a direct host relay route is not proven.
AOP voice-trigger services are separate from host-visible bridge audio.
Marconi control uses AppleSPU; its relation to host HCI symptoms is unproven.
Camera controls and AVE encoding have separate recovered owners and interfaces.

coverage.title: Sixteen-board BridgeOS policy
coverage.limit: for bridgeOS `23P6068`; revisit only for another signed build or a newly identified field.

coverage.title: J152f host boundary and APP7777 applicability
coverage.limit: for provider selection on J152f.

coverage.title: Host boundary on the other 15 boards
coverage.limit: sanitized board-indexed ACPI/PCI captures.

coverage.title: Shared upstream PCIe and DART
coverage.limit: for the static reset boundary. A cross-function quiesce/invalidate/reattach coordinator is implementation work, and any shared reset remains controlled; neither is an unperformed reversing lead.

coverage.title: Remote diagnostics and paired attribution
coverage.limit: one clock-correlated host plus bridgeOS transition capture.

coverage.title: Watchdog, panic, and crash recovery
coverage.limit: paired crash/watchdog records from the same transition.

coverage.title: AppleSMC and PMGR completion/wake fabric
coverage.limit: typed consumers for the remaining event selectors and a caller or symbolized table that names the PMGR routing values. The retained dispatcher, consumer, table, and literal searches exhausted their direct edges; bytes 0-3 cannot supply status because this dispatcher never reads them.

coverage.title: BCE ordinary sleep selection
coverage.limit: do not conflate it with hibernate or controller acceptance.

coverage.title: VHCI, internal USB, reset, and wake
coverage.limit: for the static state/reset map. Adding and testing a VHCI epoch plus BCE-function quarantine/rebuild is off-device implementation work, not outstanding firmware analysis; shared PERST remains outside the VHCI owner.

coverage.title: Hibernate as a whole chain
coverage.limit: any S4 qualification requires a recovery-aware, controlled session after static dependency review.

coverage.title: Host ANS2/root storage
coverage.limit: for the host/T2 controller and typed-command boundary. Any new health UI can use the already typed generic NVMe interfaces; firmware update and hibernate qualification are separate implementation/runtime projects, not a static raw-tunnel lead.

coverage.title: BridgeOS internal ANS/NVMe and xART
coverage.limit: for the transport boundary; creator recovery is a separate vendor workflow.

coverage.title: SEP services beyond biometrics
coverage.limit: for owner, ordering, and causal relevance. Endpoint-specific hold/abort/restart support is protocol implementation work and requires per-service acceptance evidence; it is not a generic PM callback left to discover in the reviewed Linux driver.

coverage.title: Touch ID lifecycle
coverage.limit: for compatibility discovery; track productization separately.

coverage.title: Boot and EFI policy
coverage.limit: for the feasible writer, threshold, and direct fallback graph. Resolving the unnamed selectors, predicates, or backend requires a symbolized sibling or controlled trace; another string/direct-branch scan cannot supply them.

coverage.title: Firmware update, erase, and device-mode recovery
coverage.limit: for the retained static transaction graph. Exact return-to-original, fail-forward, or recovery-mode selection requires a matched persisted checkpoint/NVRAM snapshot across failure; update execution was not part of this analysis.

coverage.title: Intel panel, EDID, and MacEFI sequencing
coverage.limit: for panel timing; lane count and link rate belong to the route/active-link measurement boundary.

coverage.title: gmux ownership and switch transaction
coverage.limit: a gmux/SMC register definition, board-level rail map, or controlled correlation trace that gives port `0x58` device semantics. Exhaustive command/caller/readback review found only writes. The prepare/switch/validate/abort transaction is now implementation design and remains separate from that missing meaning.

coverage.title: AMD/HDA/root-port power, reset, and runtime switch
coverage.limit: require a validated abort path and known recovery route before power, reset, switch, or suspend tests.

coverage.title: Bridge-audio endpoint state and PM revalidation
coverage.limit: for ownership, negative replay, and defect discovery. Implementation remains blocked on a safe client-publication protocol, reverse-order SQ/CQ/DMA unwind, IRQ-dispatch quiescence, owned draining of both dynamic work classes, failure injection, and concurrent PM/shutdown/IRQ/work tests before build and hardware qualification.

coverage.title: Playback clock, codec, DSP, jack, and speaker protection
coverage.limit: for static framing and the missing Linux field. Parser/pointer integration is implementation work; timestamp units, simultaneous-direction sharing, and symptom attribution require a matched runtime trace and remain runtime qualification, not static guesses.

coverage.title: AOP audio and voice trigger
coverage.limit: for the retained static controller and host packet paths. Establishing timestamp units/byte-count relation requires the producer-side timebase contract or matched trace; default enablement is a product decision.

coverage.title: AppleSMC charging and thermal policy
coverage.limit: runtime `getKeyInfo` output or the producer-side key table for declared types, plus typed consumers for remaining event selectors. Host call-site, imported-accessor, serializer, and raw-key scans exhausted the retained static scale/layout evidence; no write is justified.

coverage.title: Battery/charging symptom
coverage.limit: next evidence is a bounded, board-specific event/key/USB-PD trace, not a policy write.

coverage.title: AOP sensors and timesync
coverage.limit: the AOP ready/service assignment plus one producer-side accel/gyro/pressure sample and calibration path tied to the recovered dynamic interface and timestamp envelope. Host-side executable analysis is complete; cross-generation endpoint tables cannot fill the producer edge.

coverage.title: HIDSPI updater, reset policy, and report 0x7e
coverage.limit: for declared structure; counter semantics need a read-only sample.

coverage.title: Multitouch, Force Touch, palm, and report bodies
coverage.limit: the build-matched `MultitouchHID.plugin` or equivalent user-client consumer that maps admitted IDs to lengths and fields. The retained AFU caller/copy lane is complete and cannot supply that host-side edge; do not reuse internal layouts as contact fields.

coverage.title: Touch Bar display personality
coverage.limit: the bridgeOS USB gadget/personality binary that selects and initializes configuration 2, plus its 856-byte HID descriptor or an already retained macOS descriptor capture. The named component and broad identity searches failed; live configuration switching remains controlled.

coverage.title: Lid-angle sensor (LAS)
coverage.limit: any further work requires controlled stimulus-correlated report-1 sampling or a validated parser for other reports; do not send output report 6.

coverage.title: Camera controls, exposure, privacy, teardown, and reopen
coverage.limit: the selector-7 dispatch-table edge into the recovered gated routine, the `AppleUVCCamera` policy-to-property-0 caller, and an identified privacy/LED controller or a trace establishing that relationship. `SEPCameraDisable` belongs to SEP metadata and does not prove camera privacy ownership; no XU request is valid because the bitmap enables none.

coverage.title: T2 media encoder
coverage.limit: for retained static command `0x02` and callback `0x0b`. Further confidence requires board-scoped runtime qualification and negative/safety testing, not more corpus searching.

coverage.title: Wi-Fi
coverage.limit: require a board-bound firmware/NVRAM/control trace to move beyond symptom.

coverage.title: Bluetooth and AOP control
coverage.limit: non-disruptively confirm dynamic-service presence and correlate power requests with host HCI lifecycle before any reset hypothesis.

coverage.title: USB-C and Thunderbolt
coverage.limit: controlled devices and a recovery-aware hotplug/wake matrix after static review of the helper.

coverage.title: Desktop Ethernet
coverage.limit: the J185/J185f AOP-I2C application/service binary or typed message trace, and J160 register definitions if implementation proceeds. All-board and executable/class searches found topology but no AOP owner or declared user-client implementation.

coverage.title: RTC and persistent time
coverage.limit: the host-side provider/helper implementation that defines transport, epoch/unit conversion, and alarms, or a typed comparator trace. DeviceTree, RTC-component, iBoot, and experimental-driver review found no such contract; no RTC write is justified.

coverage.title: Physical xHCI outside BCE
coverage.limit: trace exact PCI/platform ordering only after a non-disruptive instrumentation plan.

coverage.title: Internal keyboard and backlight
coverage.limit: collect board-bound IDs and post-transition acceptance only when a safe platform transition exists.
